# Isolated upstream reference files

Selected files are copies with personal nonfunctional comments sanitized from the supplied h3-film-main archive. SOURCE_MANIFEST.json records source paths and current sanitized-file SHA-256 hashes. No upstream commit was verified. They are included as private reference material at the owner's request, not as a vendored dependency. Our Python runner does not import or execute them.

The source identifies [private-project-source] No root source-code license was found in the supplied archive. A relayed permission to copy does not create a public redistribution license. Keep this export private until rights are cleared. Preserve the source attribution. Nonfunctional personal comments were sanitized; the source attribution URL is retained.

These files are NOT a runnable copy of the upstream system. The exact Comfy graph and Modal wrapper used for the audit are now preserved, but dependencies, models, fonts, GPU environment and account configuration are not bundled. They contain provider calls and process execution. Do not run them merely because this export's local tests pass.

The fresh audio-first implementation is under magicdrama/audiofirst. It shares design ideas, not these modules' runtime. Timed frame pinning and exact-audio inpainting remain unavailable in the documented Magic Hour adapter; measured output failed speaker/lip-sync QA on 2026-10-25. A shot requiring fixed audio or timed pins must use the original Comfy/Modal route after runtime/cost approval, or fail closed.
